Task 1 is complete.

## Summary

Implemented control-character and fused-acceptance-line linting plus the planner file-tool instruction.

**Changes (all within scope):**
- `src/core/linter.ts` — recursive scan of all authored change-folder files (skipping `.run`, `.git`, `.DS_Store`) rejecting ASCII control chars `0x00-0x1F`/`0x7F` except `\n` and `\t`; per-line fused acceptance detection (`>1` checkbox); integrated into `lintChangeFolder` so both `lint` and `approve` fail closed.
- `src/core/init.ts` + `PLANNER.md` — added `- Write files with the file tool, never through a shell echo.` to the managed planner block.
- `tests/mangled-lint.test.ts` (new) and `tests/init-planner.test.ts` — tests for every acceptance line.

**Verification:** `node --import tsx --test tests/mangled-lint.test.ts tests/init-planner.test.ts` → 16 pass / 0 fail. Also `tests/linter.test.ts` + `tests/approve.test.ts` (34 pass) and `pnpm tsc --noEmit` clean.

Note: the `" and "` title warning removal belongs to task 4, so it was left untouched. Result written to `.run/results/1.md`.
